title: Unifying Early and Late Dark Energy: Dynamical Requirements and Obstructions (Giare & Sakstein)
efc_relevance: Shows that any single-scalar potential unifying EDE (for H0) and late-DE (for DESI DR2 w(z)) requires a steep–steeper–shallow slope hierarchy that is generically hard to construct without fine-tuning. Sharpens the comparison between EFC (which unifies pre- and late-acceleration through a single S-flow regime structure, not a single scalar potential) and the EDE+late-DE competitor class.
ledger_action: Add to External Research Ledger under cluster dark-energy-parametrization; update framework:EDE-Poulin2019 row with single-scalar-unification obstruction note; required comparison row in WP3 Falsification Protocol where EFC's L0→L3 unification mechanism is contrasted with single-scalar potential approaches on a tuning-cost metric.
